name: Proto-Man
desc: The Key, created as a result of countless experiments, was supposed to help the Belyi Tsar become the Primordial Human.

customize.name: Belyi Tsar
customize.desc: Monomakh Snezhnyi was the Tsar of all Fae and the first Cryo Archon.

customize.text:
Ancient Hyperboreans created Monomakh from the remnants of the deceased primeval Cryo Sovereign to become the Primordial Human and rule humanity. As the
that once ruled the ancient universe had not yet been extinguished, he couldn't rule humanity and create the Court of Bliss. Thus, researchers from Hvergelmir created a Proto-Man, whose mind was to unite with the body of the Belyi Tsar to complete the Primordial Human.
After Belyi Tsar's death, Proto-Man realized that his becoming the Transcendent would inevitably usher in the transformation of the world, so he persuaded

customize.name: Pavlina
customize.desc: Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka from the House of Hesperides.

customize.name: Koshchei
customize.desc: A bio-alchemist and researcher from Hvergelmir. He is also known as Doctor Moreau.

customize.name: Aksinya
customize.desc: The leading researcher of Hvergelmir, who created the Eye of Graeae and worked on the creation of the Primordial Human.

customize.text:
and seal her in the Shadow Realm. He promised the researchers the opportunity to use his power to achieve their goals, and they divided his body into three parts.
Court of Bliss
The world of tomorrow that was supposed to be created in the

. A realm that has cast aside envy, where all shall be able to love one another as in the very beginning, and this love shall be, in nature, everlasting. There is no distinction between human and human, nor between human and god. A pure world of mankind, where gods need not wield divine power, and humans need not rely on gods.

customize.name: Zver
customize.desc: The leader of the bio-alchemically created monsters in service of the Belyi Tsar.

customize.text: Proto-Man's "brother," created by Koshchei. He guarded the Belyi Tsar.

customize.name: Eye of Graeae
customize.desc:
A strange mechanism you encountered in an abandoned station. It often appears in the form of a monocle.

It offers many convenient functions, such as recording blueprints for Prime Ice constructs, creating Prime Ice, calling trains.

...Perhaps it was built for the very purpose of providing all these conveniences.

customize.text: After the Proto-Man's body was divided into three parts, his consciousness remained in the mechanism created by Aksinya. Although he lost all his memories, he remembered that he needed to retrieve the fragments of his power. To accomplish this mission, he chose the Descender, the Traveler.

customize.name: Pavlina
customize.desc: Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka from the House of Hesperides.

customize.text: used a fragment of Proto-Man's power for a ritual to imbue the Snegovik with souls. Using the Prime Ice, she created a body for this portion of power named Ikhor. During the ritual, she absorbed Proto-Man's power, destroying Ikhor. The fragments of Proto-Man's body, which had initially turned into shards, then crystallized again after the ritual.

customize.name: Pebble of Crystalline Essence
customize.desc:
An egg-shaped stone infused with the power required for the Eye of Graeae to reclaim his physical form.
Once divided and seized by the Domovoy Grand Duke Alvis, its power was acquired by Aksinya through unknown means and placed within the hollow remains of Hvergelmir. Hidden within it may lie the secret of how, through rebirth, a mere mortal might transcend into a more perfect being.

customize.name: Pebble of Freezing Heart
customize.desc:
An egg-shaped stone infused with the power required for the Eye of Graeae to reclaim his physical form.
Once used by the fae Grand Duchess Pavlina to remedy the inherent flaws of the fae.
Hidden within it may lie the aspiration of how a mere mortal might ascend to a higher status through rebirth.

customize.name: Pebble of Serpentine Algae
customize.desc:
An egg-shaped stone infused with the power required for the Eye of Graeae to reclaim his physical form.
Once used by the alchemist named Koshchei to create life in pursuit of eternity.
Hidden within it may lie the revelation of how a mere mortal might forge immortality through rebirth.

customize.name: Severed Fragment of Ikhor
customize.desc:
A fragment of Ikhor's power, split off by Aksinya when the "ritual" was interrupted.
For some reason, it has taken the form of a glowing doll. Perhaps the desire to "fulfill the wishes of others" became the strings that controlled him long ago, and now he is nothing more than a puppet carrying a form of transcendent power.

desc.text:
...The experiment is complete.
Aksinya believes it finished as per its designated direction, and thus, a success. And indeed, it is a grand endeavor most worthy of praise.
But can this really be called a success?
So-called eternal love... the so-called courtyard of eternal bliss...
Is that is not merely a dead end with neither change nor improvement?
...
What "shared love"? Is this the world she desires, where all shall love all... Yet love should not be such a thing.
If all differences in this world were to disappear, and all were to be blended into one, what would we be "loving," precisely?
There would be nothing to project love outward upon, nor would there be any corresponding entity within to love.
A "love" created by removing the key elements behind love is nothing but a falsehood, an empty shell.
...
The person within the egg is right.
"He" speaks truth. Aksinya has not perceived the terrifying essence of eternal love.
I cannot... allow her plan to come to final fruition. His Majesty Monomakh has passed, but I know she has not given up simply on that account...
Before the time comes, we must stop her. The person within the egg... I agree with "his" plan.
I know, however, that she will one day surely return, breaking free from the shackles of the land of shadows.
When that time comes, I shall prove to her... that love will not be eroded by cold silence, not even in the grand scheme of eternity.

(A note, written in a cold, stiff hand with almost no variation...)
"...The prisoners used as experimental material have already been handed over to Alvis. There is no doubt that the results of that experiment were 'incorrect.'"
"But is that what humans... Is that what loveless fae should seek as 'love'? Perhaps the Snegovik, incomplete in spirit as they are, truly could make use of this technology..."
"To gain the 'love' they lacked from the beginning. Just as... just as 'he' told me, dreams that are too grand have no meaning. Perhaps..."
"Perhaps 'he' was right. That power... That power should have been ours from the start, as compensation. It was never meant to belong to Aksinya's aberrant dream."
"...I will stop here before Alvis 'accidentally' comes across this again and causes more trouble."

...Even after His Majesty's passing, Hvergelmir remains within my control. This, perhaps, is why His Majesty entrusted everything to me while he yet walked amongst us.
An alchemist who knows only to trample life into the mud, a young Snegurochka dissatisfied with her own race, and... sigh Aksinya, the Court Jester whom His Majesty coddled all too much...
How could they possibly survive this tumultuous situation on their own?
They will still have to rely on my methods, will they not?
...
Yet we Domovoy were never ones to do business at a loss, Your Majesty, the late, great, Belyi Tsar...
Naturally, I have the means to protect this secret chamber, sitting precariously as it does like an egg in an overturned nest. But all within it shall be mine to claim.
The great sighing in my mind has grown more frequent.
The person in the egg, the creature who was created... dares to lecture me?
Yet "his" words are not bereft of sense.
...
I will have vengeance upon [...], yet this move must not be discovered by the one who sits upon the new throne...
The destruction of Kitezhgrad appears to me a perfect opportunity to avoid the cleansing directed at [...]
Snezhnaya shall need a new Kitezhgrad, and that shall be my great work. Once accomplished, even the one on the new throne shall have no choice but to acknowledge me.
Before that, I should... I shall get the share I deserve. It is what "he" promised to me. I must obtain that power.
And after that, once Novokitezhgrad has been established, we can move Hvergelmir to that new city in secret.
Everything here shall be of aid to my research... All so I can get closer... to that person within my mind...

imgDesc.text: A body created in the image of the Belyi Tsar in his youth.
Proto-Man in the mechanism called the Eye of Graeae and its creator, Aksinya.
